info.name: Sakura Sushi & Izakaya Lounge
info.tagline: Artisanal Omakase, Fresh Nigiri, and Robata Charcoal Grill
info.address: 512 Cherry Blossom Way, Downtown Arts District, Seattle, WA 98101
info.hours: Tuesday–Thursday: 12:00 PM – 10:00 PM | Friday–Saturday: 12:00 PM – 11:00 PM | Sunday: 4:00 PM – 9:30 PM | Monday: Closed
info.payment: All Major Credit Cards (Visa, MC, Amex), Contactless Tap-to-Pay, Apple Pay, and Cash. Maximum 4 card splits per party.
info.reservations: Required for Omakase chef counter seating. Main dining room walk-ins welcome based on availability. 2-hour table seating policy.
info.takeout: Omakase is dine-in only. Bento boxes, rolls, and hot entrees available for pickup via Toast Tab and delivery via Grubhub.
info.parking: Valet parking available at entrance for $12 flat fee; validated garage parking across the street for up to 3 hours.
info.dress: No strong personal perfumes or colognes permitted out of respect for delicate sushi aromas. Smart casual dress code.
info.alcohol: Curated sake, Japanese craft beer, and Japanese whisky selection. 21+ photo ID strictly verified. Corkage fee is $30 per 720ml bottle.
